clauses.statement: buildEvidenceKeyInputs excludes head_sha, head_ref, and wall-clock verification timestamps (verification_command_timestamps / verification_evidence_updated_at) from the evidence-reuse key_inputs, and instead composes role_surface_digests -- a "<stage>:<role>" -> {mode, digest} map built by buildRoleContentDigests from each role's inspected content-surface hash, or, for a strict_head role, the current head_sha.
clauses.rationale: Root cause of the Story's measured cost problem (CRK-S-1 AC, Background): head_sha/head_ref and verification timestamps moved on every fix commit and every verification re-run, so the pre-existing key changed on every iteration and forced full-artifact regeneration and full review-panel re-dispatch even when nothing a reviewer had actually inspected changed. See architecture doc section 'Old vs new key composition'.

story_refs.text_snippet: CRK-S-1: evidence reuse keyから head_sha / head_ref と壁時計timestamp（verification_command_timestamps / verification_evidence_updated_at）を除外し、ロールごとのinspected content surface digest（content-binding由来）で構成する。

clauses.statement: buildRoleContentDigests classifies a role as mode: 'strict_head' whenever that role's own last-recorded freshness_policy.effective_mode === 'strict_head' (never via a hardcoded role-name list), and for such a role its role_surface_digests entry holds the current head_sha rather than a content hash, so compareEvidenceReuse / evaluateEvidenceReuseForReview mark that role's reuse status: miss on every HEAD change regardless of whether its inspected content actually changed.
clauses.rationale: CRK-S-3 AC requires that roles configured with freshness_mode: strict_head keep re-reviewing on every head change, and the Story Non Goals forbid changing strict-HEAD-role policy. strict_head is not a built-in role-name list: it is set per role via .vibepro/config.json agent_reviews.roles.<role>.freshness_mode with a freshness_reason, and resolved generically through role.freshness_policy.effective_mode. gate_evidence and release_risk carry no such entry on this branch or on origin/main, so they run under the content_surface default both before and after this Story. Hardcoding those role names would itself have been a behavior change, which is why architecture doc section D1 rejects it.

story_refs.text_snippet: CRK-S-3: `freshness_mode: strict_head`が設定されたロール（ロール名のハードコードではなく、`.vibepro/config.json` `agent_reviews.roles.<role>.freshness_mode: strict_head` + `freshness_reason`で個別設定され、`role.freshness_policy.effective_mode`で汎用判定される）は従来どおりhead変更で再レビューされ、本Storyの対象外として挙動が変わらない。`gate_evidence` / `release_risk` は現状デフォルトの`content_surface`で運用されており（strict_head固定ロールではない）、この扱いも本Storyでは変わらない。

diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    Review[recorded review: content_binding.recorded_surface_hash] --> KeyBuild
    Tree[current git tree at pr prepare or review prepare time] --> KeyBuild[buildRoleContentDigests re-hash per stage and role]
    KeyBuild --> RoleDigests[role_surface_digests in key_inputs]
    RoleDigests --> BaseCompare[compareEvidenceReuse base fields only]
    Fingerprints[spec_fingerprint, risk_surface_fingerprint, planner_version] --> BaseCompare
    BaseCompare --> RoleCompare[buildRoleReuseIndex per role_reuse entry]
    RoleDigests --> RoleCompare
    RoleCompare --> Artifact[evidence-reuse.json role_reuse and stale_reasons]
    Artifact --> ReviewPrepare[evaluateEvidenceReuseForReview by_role]
    HeadCtx[reviewer current head_sha] --> ReviewPrepare

    subgraph Threats
        T1[a stale content_binding hash is never re-verified against the current tree, masking a real content change as a hit]
        T2[a security sensitive role is left on the default content_surface mode instead of an explicit strict_head opt in]
        T3[a base fingerprint silently stops varying with its input, so base invalidation never fires]
        T4[decision_outcome_summary is exposed across a HEAD mismatch once role freshness became content scoped]
    end

    KeyBuild -.-> T1
    RoleDigests -.-> T2
    BaseCompare -.-> T3
    ReviewPrepare -.-> T4

    T1 -->|mitigation| M1[buildRoleContentDigests re-hashes the CURRENT tree on every key build and every review prepare call, never trusts a stored hash alone]
    T2 -->|mitigation| M2[normalizeAgentReviewPolicy rejects a global strict_head default; strict_head is an explicit per-role opt in with a freshness_reason]
    T3 -->|mitigation| M3[base_reuse runs unconditionally before any role comparison and forces every role_reuse entry to miss on base drift, pinned by the CRK-S-4 CRK-S-6 contract test]
    T4 -->|mitigation| M4[decision_outcome_summary stays gated on recorded_git.head_sha versus the reviewer current head_sha, independent of role_reuse mode]
